annotations.title: Daylight Saving Transition Dates (IANA Time Zone)

description: Find when the clocks change in a time zone in a year. Send an IANA time zone name (America/New_York, Europe/London, Australia/Sydney) and a year (1990 to 2100). Get back each change of UTC offset in that year, in order: the date and the clock time it happens, the time it jumps to, the UTC offset and abbreviation before and after, the exact UTC instant, whether clocks go forward or back, how many minutes, whether it is a daylight saving change or a change of the zone's standard offset, and the local times skipped or repeated. A zone with no clock change that year says so, with its offset. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/dst-transition-dates). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

label.description: Optional label (your own text, echoed back; not a person).

year.description: Calendar year (local clock) to look in, 1990 to 2100.

zone.description: IANA time zone name, e.g. America/New_York, Europe/Paris, Australia/Lord_Howe, UTC.
